title: Network Security & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Provitious Technologies Private Limited
  
**Experience:**
3–5 Years
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
**Department:**
Cloud Infrastructure & Managed IT Services
  
**Primary Technology:**
Fortinet FortiGate
  
**Preferred Cloud Platforms:**
AWS and Microsoft Azure
  
**About the Role**
:
  
Provitius Technologies is looking for a skilled Network Security & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with hands-on experience in Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, network security, infrastructure administration, and cloud environments.
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing network security infrastructure, configuring and maintaining FortiGate firewalls, monitoring network performance, troubleshooting connectivity issues, and implementing security policies.
  
Candidates with additional experience in AWS, Microsoft Azure, cloud networking, and DevOps practices will be highly preferred.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
**Network Security & FortiGate Administration**

* Configure, manage, and maintain Fortinet FortiGate firewalls.
* Implement firewall policies, security rules, NAT, routing, and access control.
* Configure and manage IPsec and SSL VPN connections.
* Monitor firewall logs, security events, and network traffic.
* Troubleshoot firewall-related connectivity and security issues.
* Manage firmware upgrades, configuration backups, and firewall maintenance.
* Implement security best practices and network segmentation.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network activities.

**Network Administration**

* Manage LAN, WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, and network connectivity.
* Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, and routing issues.
* Monitor network availability, performance, and bandwidth utilization.
* Handle network incidents and provide timely resolution.
* Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and configuration records.

**Cloud Infrastructure – AWS & Azure (Preferred)**

* Manage and support cloud infrastructure across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
* Configure and manage cloud networking components.
* Work with AWS VPC, Subnets, Security Groups, Network ACLs, Route Tables, and VPN connectivity.
* Work with Azure Virtual Networks, NSGs, VPN Gateway, and Network Security configurations.
* Implement secure connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud environments.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and security.
* Support cloud infrastructure deployment and troubleshooting.

**DevOps & Infrastructure Automation (Preferred)**

* Support infrastructure provisioning and configuration automation.
* Work with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
* Understand CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
* Experience with Git, scripting, and infrastructure automation.
* Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows Server administration.
* Support containerized infrastructure using Docker where required.

**Monitoring, Documentation & Support**

* Monitor network and infrastructure health.
* Investigate and resolve infrastructure and security incidents.
* Maintain incident reports, troubleshooting records, and change logs.
* Coordinate with internal teams and customers for infrastructure support.
* Follow change management, incident management, and security procedures.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* 3–5 years of experience in Network Administration, Network Security, or Infrastructure Engineering
* .Hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls
* .Strong understanding of firewall policies, NAT, routing, VPN, and network security
* .Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, LAN and WAN
* .Experience in troubleshooting network connectivity and security incidents
* .Knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration
* .Good communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills

.
  
  
Preferred Skills:

* AWS infrastructure and networking experience
* .Microsoft Azure infrastructure and networking experience
* .AWS VPC, Security Groups, VPN and routing
* .Azure VNet, NSG, VPN Gateway and connectivity
* .Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
* .CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* .Python, Bash, or PowerShell scripting
* .Docker and container infrastructure
* .Fortinet NSE / FCP certifications or equivalent Fortinet certifications
* .AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator certifications

.

title: IT Infra & ERP Expert
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and analytical professional with Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline. At least 10 years of experience in ERP/SAP systems, asset databases, digital records management, IT infrastructure, automation systems, or data analytics. The ideal candidate should have strong skills in project management, research, data analysis, stakeholder engagement, and client coordination, with experience in preparing reports, presentations, and supporting planning and consulting assignments.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
• Manage and review ERP/SAP systems and digital asset databases.
  
• Maintain and validate digital records, asset registers, and project documentation.
  
• Assess IT infrastructure and automation systems supporting asset management.
  
• Conduct data analytics, data validation, and reconciliation of asset records.
  
• Identify gaps in digital records and recommend improvements in data management systems.
  
• Support asset verification through digital tools and technology-enabled processes.
  
• Prepare analytical reports and dashboards to support project assessment and decision-making.
  
• Ensure data accuracy, integrity, security, and proper documentation of digital records
  
Desired Candidate Profile
  
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline.
  
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in ERP/SAP systems, IT infrastructure, or digital asset management.
  
• Expertise in asset databases, digital records management, and data management systems.
  
• Experience in automation systems, data analytics, and technology-driven process improvement.
  
• Strong analytical and technical skills to support asset verification, data validation, and digital reporting.

title: Network Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to join our team in Gujarat. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and maintaining network systems, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. As a Network Engineer, you will work closely with other IT professionals to design, implement, and troubleshoot network solutions that meet the needs of our organization. Key responsibilities include monitoring network performance, configuring network devices, and assisting in network expansion projects. You will also be involved in procuring network equipment and ensuring that all systems are up to date with the latest technology. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Required skills include knowledge of network engineering principles, experience with network equipment procurement, and familiarity with network expansion strategies. If you are passionate about networking and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Job description**

**Job Title: IT Infrastructure Engineer**

**Location: Gandhinagar, Adalaj**

**Experience: 1 to 3 years**

Overview

We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, deploy, and maintain the core hardware, software, network, and cloud foundations that keep a company’s technology systems running. Person should manage physical and virtual servers, enterprise storage, local/wide-area networks (LAN/WAN), firewalls, and cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

Design & Deployment: Architect and implement scalable infrastructure blueprints, virtual machines (VMs), and container platforms. Should have a knowledge of Windows Active Directory and MS Office Administration.

System Administration: Maintain operating systems (Windows Server, Linux), Active Directory, identity access management (IAM), and patching routines.

Network & Security: Oversee routers, switches, VPNs, firewalls, and data backup/disaster recovery procedures

Automation & IaC: Write scripts (PowerShell, Python) and use Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform) to automate provisioning and deployments

Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Build observability dashboards, analyse CPU/storage metrics, and provide Tier III incident support

Vendor & Compliance Management: Partner with hardware/cloud vendors and enforce organizational security and data privacy policies. Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution.

Required Technical Skills

Networking & Protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewall configuration. Proven hands-on network engineering experience.

Operating Systems: Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu) and Windows Server.

Cloud & Virtualization: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, VMware, or Docker/Kubernetes.

Monitoring and Analytics: Hands-on experience with monitoring, network diagnostic and network analytics tools

Qualifications & Experience

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (preferred).
* Experience: 1–3 years of demonstrable agency experience.
* Soft Skills: Strong troubleshooting abilities, deadline ownership, and clear communication.
